title: Cache a per-user count and invalidate it on change
prompt: Add GET /notes/stats, which returns { "count": <number of the signed-in user's notes> }. Counting is slow in production, so cache each user's result for 5 minutes with Inferlo's built-in cache (not a Map of your own), tagged "notes". Creating or deleting a note through the API must invalidate that tag, so the next GET /notes/stats is correct. Users must never see another user's count.
